Census for this type: the only `cocos_label_transformation` resolvers in the tree are the duplicates the plan already names — `imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py:411` and `imas_ambix/data/tokamap_export.py:147` — and no third resolver exists (`grep -rn cocos_label_transformation imas_ambix/`), so the plan's duplicate_owner catch is complete for that mechanism.
findings.text: §6 puts the equilibrium-database grid record "under the same `{shot}.zarr/{category}/{name}` layout and the same refuse-to-overwrite rule" as channels and shares only the token and overwrite contract, but the layout itself is owned by `channel_path`/`channel_time_path` (`imas_ambix/data/eddb.py:106,120`); the plan does not name that owner for the grid writer, and a second path construction beside `channel_path` would fork the store layout the shared-store claim depends on being single
